question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

6 ÷ 48 + 12 × 9 - 7 = 35
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] Given statement : 6 ÷ 48 + 12 × 9 - 7 = 35 According to the question, after interchanging the signs: So, __ • Option - (1) : ÷ and +​ Given statement : 6 ÷ 48 + 12 × 9 - 7 = 35 After interchanging: 6 + **48 ÷ 12**__ × 9 - 7 = 35 6 + __**4 **____**× 9**__ - 7 = 35 __**6 + 36**__ - 7 = 35 __**42 - 7**__ = 35
